description_en: Creates an interactive messaging application by calling CreateLiveMessageApp
description_zh: 调用CreateLiveMessageApp创建互动消息应用
kebab_example: aliyun live create-live-message-app --app-name testApp --audit-type 2 --audit-url http://demo.aliyundoc.com/exampleaudit --event-callback-url http://demo.aliyundoc.com/examplecallback --data-center cn-shanghai --msg-life-cycle 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateLiveMessageApp

parameters.help_en: The application name. The name must be 2 to 16 characters in length
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en:
The security audit mode. Valid values:
0: default value. Security audit is disabled.
1: built-in security audit.
2: custom security audit
parameters.help_zh:
安全审核方式，取值：
0：默认值，不开启安全审核。
1：内置安全审核。
2：自定义安全审核
parameters.name: audit_type

parameters.help_en: The URL for custom security audit. This parameter is required when custom security audit is selected (AuditType=2). The URL must start with http:// or https://, must not contain private IP addresses, and must not include port numbers. For the format of custom security audit content, see the following section
parameters.help_zh: 如果是自定义安全审核（AuditType=2），则需要提供安全审核的地址。安全审核地址以http://或https://开头，不包含私有IP，不允许带端口号。自定义安全审核内容格式见下文
parameters.name: audit_url

parameters.help_en: The event callback URL for client logon, logout, join group, and leave group events. If this parameter is empty, event callbacks are disabled. For the callback API operations that are triggered, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2672836.html. The event callback URL must start with http:// or https://, must not contain private IP addresses, and must not include port numbers. For the event callback format and callback authentication logic, see the following section
parameters.help_zh: 客户端登录、登出、加入、离开群组等事件回调地址，若为空则不开启事件回调。触发回调接口见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2672836.html。事件回调地址以http://或https://开头，不包含私有IP，不允许带端口号。事件回调格式和回调鉴权逻辑见下文
parameters.name: event_callback_url

parameters.help_en:
The data center. Valid values:
cn-shanghai: default value. Shanghai.
ap-southeast-1: Singapore.

When calling other interactive messaging API operations, the data center must be the same as the one specified when creating the interactive messaging application
parameters.help_zh:
数据中心，枚举值：
cn-shanghai：默认值，上海。
ap-southeast-1：新加坡。

调用直播互动其他接口时，需要与当前创建直播互动应用的数据中心一致
parameters.name: data_center

parameters.help_en:
The storage duration tier for group messages within the application. Valid values:
0: default value. Messages are stored for 30 days.
1: messages are stored for 90 days.
2: messages are stored for 180 days
parameters.help_zh:
App内群组消息的存储时效档位，取值：
0：默认值，存储30天。
1：存储90天。
2：存储180天
parameters.name: msg_life_cycle

AppId.description_en: The application ID, which is used for subsequent operations such as joining groups
AppId.description_zh: 应用ID，用于后续加入群等流程

AppKey.description_en: The AppKey, which is used to generate authentication for various operations related to the AppId
AppKey.description_zh: AppKey，用于生成与该AppId相关的各种操作鉴权

AppSign.description_en: The application signature. The interactive messaging service SDK requires this information
AppSign.description_zh: 应用签名，互动消息服务SDK需要该信息
